title: TimeCraft Utils
description: A mod that contains random and sometimes useful items/blocks.
body:
A mod used solely for testing and TimeCraft Server messing around.



It contains new ores, Osmium and Lead(more to be added), that can create items such as a mirror(gives entities glowing, geiger counter(WIP), staff of lightning, and trowel. It will eventually add trees, a biome and hopefully some structures.
